summary.text: Michael Hammill is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a healthcare professional and a U.S. Navy veteran who served from 1989 to 2011.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hammill advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said prices for housing, healthcare, insurance, utilities, groceries and taxes are too high, and that jobs have left the Allegheny Valley.
He said he supports a mix of natural gas, nuclear and solar energy, and wants to upgrade and bury power lines and lower the cost of doing business.
